Scored through its own bespoke driver (scripts/run_commodity_oi_cycle_overlay_abi1.py; make_signal_fn always raises so the generic dispatch cannot mis-score it).

name: Gold-to-Copper Ratio Fear-Valuation State -> SPY Overlay (SPY core, extra 0.25x SPY while the 60-month z of ln(GC/HG) is at or above zero)
mechanism: Account shape: SPY fully invested at all times (the benchmark series itself) PLUS a margin-financed overlay of 0.25 x account equity in extra SPY, borrowed at the ^IRX bill rate with no spread charged, held only while a slow fear-valuation state is HIGH. Signal: x = ln(COMEX gold front-month continuous close / COMEX copper front-month continuous close) (Yahoo GC=F and HG=F, read from a frozen sha256-pinned cache), read at the last ACTUAL NYSE session strictly before each scheduled month-end M (the one session lag: no futures bar on or after M is ever used, because the Yahoo =F daily Close could not be verified as the COMEX settlement over the whole history); z_M = (x_M - mean of the last 60 monthly reads including x_M) / sample stdev of the same 60 reads (a fixed five-year, 60-month window that is this pipeline's own design choice, not a paper parameter); state HIGH when z_M >= 0. Month-ends are the exchange's SCHEDULED last sessions (exchange_calendars XNYS regular holidays only), never inferred from the data. Window: consecutive HIGH month-ends are merged into ONE window (entry at the close of the first HIGH scheduled month-end, exit at the close of the first later scheduled month-end that is not HIGH) because the overlay engine raises on windows that share an endpoint; the overlay holds a fixed share count set at the entry equity for the whole merged window (its borrowed principal is fixed too), so the overlay's share of account equity drifts for up to 57 months, a drift that is disclosed and not corrected. Direction follows the paper: a HIGH gold-to-copper ratio (a safe-haven premium over industrial demand) precedes higher 6 to 12 month equity excess returns, mainly in low-sentiment periods. Hole rules: a missing futures read is a causal as-of read (at most 4 calendar days stale) only before the first defined z; any missing read from the first defined z on makes the run raise and refuse, never patch. Costs: a full round trip of the real quoted SPY spread once per window. CONTROL ARMS (report-only, no ledger row of their own): an always-on 0.25 overlay with the same construction, financing, costs and tax policy, and 500 seeded random-window overlays that keep the main arm's episode count and exact episode-length multiset; a pass is evidence about the signal only if the main arm's daily-excess Sharpe is above the always-on arm's and at or above the 95th percentile of the random-window draws. Scored once, as a single pre-declared shot.

parameters.core: SPY fully invested at all times (the benchmark series itself)
parameters.signal: x = ln(GC=F close / HG=F close) read at the last actual NYSE session strictly before each scheduled month-end; z = (x - mean of the last 60 monthly reads including this one) / sample stdev of the same 60; state HIGH when z >= 0
parameters.window: consecutive HIGH month-ends merged into ONE window: entry at the close of the first HIGH scheduled month-end, exit at the close of the first later scheduled month-end that is not HIGH; the overlay share count is fixed at the entry equity for the whole merged window, so its share of account equity drifts
parameters.calendar: exchange_calendars XNYS scheduled sessions: weekdays minus regular holidays; unscheduled closures are not removed; the read date is the last ACTUAL session before the month-end
parameters.hole_rule: a missing futures read is a causal as-of read (at most 4 calendar days stale) only before the first defined z; any missing read from the first defined z on is refused, never patched
parameters.financing_rate: ^IRX 13-week bill coupon-equivalent yield of the last close strictly before each session, on the borrowed overlay notional, actual calendar days over 365, no spread
parameters.control_arms: report-only, no ledger row: an always-on overlay (same construction, state forced HIGH) and 500 seeded random-window overlays with the main arm's episode count and exact episode-length multiset

source: Kim, D., Roh, T.-Y., Yoon, S.-J. (October 2022 working paper; the current SSRN listing adds Yu You), 'When Gold Meets Copper: A Comprehensive Look at the Relative Value of Gold on Global Stock Markets', SSRN abstract 5677761 (Roh, Kim, Yoon, You; posted 29 October 2025 from the October 2022 draft). Read from the paper PDF: 23 industrialized countries, January 1990 to mid-2019, Datastream monthly SPOT prices, a LEVEL predictor (the log gold-copper ratio) in linear predictive regressions at 6-month and 1-year horizons, positive coefficients, out-of-sample Campbell-Thompson tests January 2000 to June 2019, predictability mainly from low-sentiment periods, seven gold ratios tested with the gold-copper one reported as strong; journal publication status UNVERIFIED (an SSRN working paper only). The paper reports mean-variance forecast allocations, NOT a trading rule: the 60-month z state, the z >= 0 threshold, the 0.25 notional, the one session lag, the merged window and the hole rules are this pipeline's own pre-registered constants. Side evidence that the ratio is not a fast leading indicator: Parnes (2024), 'Copper-to-gold ratio as a leading indicator for the 10-Year Treasury yield', North American Journal of Economics and Finance 69(A) (a lead of only a few days). HONEST LIMITS: (1) the paper used Datastream spot prices, this rule uses COMEX front-month continuous futures from Yahoo (a vendor splice, unadjusted across contract rolls, frozen with a sha256); the 2025 copper tariff episode opened a large COMEX premium over London spot and the largest one-day log-ratio change coincides with it: disclose-only, no winsorising (under the one session lag that day is not any month's read); (2) selection: seven gold ratios were tested and only this one is strong, in-sample 1990-2019; (3) the evidence is thin: a slow monthly state forms only a handful of HIGH episodes, so a few long episodes can carry most of the HIGH months and the ABI-1 holdout may be descriptive only and the daily-iid DSR counts thousands of sessions as independent bets where the real evidence is a few independent episodes; (4) the state is a commodity-price valuation state, not a re-labelled VIX fear state; (5) an always-on 0.25 SPY overlay earns most of the equity premium on its own (an unconditional baseline, before this pipeline's lag, financing, costs and tax), which is why a pass that does not beat the always-on and random-window controls means nothing; (6) the Yahoo =F daily Close was found consistent with the COMEX settlement time (gold 13:30 ET, copper 13:00 ET; gold tight, copper noisier) only over a short recent sample of sessions and could not be verified as the settlement earlier, so the one session lag is applied; (7) a fixed share count held for up to 57 months lets the overlay's share of equity drift from 0.25 (0.21 after SPY doubles, 0.30 after it halves, 0.32 after a 60 percent fall), for the main arm and both controls; the always-on control's single window is long-term and pays no modelled tax (long-term at the 0.0 rate), not merely deferred, because the pipeline's long-term rate is 0.0 by design (the same rate leaves most of the main arm's window-days untaxed), so the interpretation rule's comparison of the main arm's taxed Sharpe with the always-on arm's taxed Sharpe is tax-asymmetric: every arm's untaxed Sharpe, the untaxed-basis comparison and the count of windows and of window calendar days held over 365 days (computed from the run's own trades) are printed, the pre-declared interpretation rule itself is unchanged, and the random-window arm is the exposure-matched comparison; (8) NOT ALL CHOSEN BLIND: signal-only descriptive statistics of these series (no returns) were examined before the constants were fixed, outside the trial ledger, so DSR's trial count does not charge them; no constant was tuned against an ABI-1 score; (9) THIN VENDOR PRINTS: the frozen GC=F and HG=F files carry zero-volume rows, mostly in the early years, and a few read dates fall on them; the frozen sha256 cache, not the live vendor, is what is scored. A real margin rate adds a spread over the bill rate that is NOT modelled and this flatters the strategy, and windows held over 365 days are untaxed at the pipeline's 0.0 long-term rate (a documented, flagged assumption in constants.py), which also flatters it; taxable account only because the overlay is borrowed. RISK LAYER (the risk-basis rule): ABI-1's four risk refusals (the 0.35 absolute drawdown cap, drawdown no worse than SPY's, longest losing-week streak no longer than SPY's, worst 8-week stretch no worse than SPY's) are measured on the overlay-only excess account, the account's daily arithmetic excess over SPY in units of whole-account equity, not on the whole SPY-core account. Data: Yahoo GC=F and HG=F closes frozen under data/mining/gold_copper with a sha256 manifest; yfinance daily SPY and ^IRX; ex-ante NYSE schedule from exchange_calendars XNYS (regular holidays only).
distinctness_note: A ratio of two commodity prices (gold over copper) as a slow 60-month valuation state, expressed as an SPY overlay held over merged HIGH windows, scored through its own bespoke driver (scripts/run_gold_copper_overlay_abi1.py; make_signal_fn always raises so the generic dispatch cannot mis-score it). No catalog family uses a commodity ratio (no other catalog row or source module uses a gold/copper or copper/gold ratio). Nearest families: vix_spike_reversal_equity_buy is a fast 10-day volatility-spike reversal, whereas this is a 6 to 12 month value-type state; real_rate_gold_equity_rotation uses gold only as an asset in a flat/cash rotation on real rates, and there is no gold/copper ratio anywhere in the catalog (a sibling family uses copper open interest, a different quantity); commodity_currency_leadlag is a currency-led commodity lead-lag, not a gold-over-copper ratio. Many families are cross-asset risk-appetite ratio regimes (HYG/LQD, TLT/SHY, RSP/SPY, XLY/XLP), but all of those are flat/cash rotations; the SPY-plus-overlay shape with a commodity fear-valuation information source is new. An always-on and a random-window control are built in because an unconditional 0.25 SPY overlay earns most of the equity premium on its own.

name: Residual (idiosyncratic) momentum, top-50 cohort of the large-cap panel, monthly (SPY core plus a cohort-minus-eligible-basket overlay)
mechanism: UNIVERSE: the project's cached US large-cap panel (S&P 500 + Nasdaq-100 constituents scraped 2026-08-29, today's members), minus HUBB and MNST (documented vendor defects), minus the duplicate share classes GOOGL, FOX and NWSA (kept GOOG, FOXA, NWS), minus any name that fails the interior-gap, stale-history, closed-day or quote checks. SIGNAL at the close of the last exchange session of month M: (1) monthly total returns from month-end auto-adjusted closes at the exact month-end session (no forward fill) for every name and for three tradeable factor proxies: MKT = SPY, SMB-proxy = IWM minus SPY, HML-proxy = IVE minus IVW. (2) For each name with a full 36 monthly returns (months M-35..M), OLS on raw returns: R_i = a + b1*MKT + b2*SMB + b3*HML + e (no risk-free subtraction; the risk-free leg is common to every name so it is rank-neutral to first order). (3) Score S_i = sum of e over months M-11..M-1 (the just-ended month M is skipped) divided by the sample standard deviation of those same 11 residuals (Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011; Hanauer-Windmuller restatement). (4) Cohort = the 50 highest S_i, ties by ticker ascending (scores within a relative 1e-12 of each other count as one tie, so a last-bit rounding difference between two identical histories cannot decide it). ENTRY: the open of the first exchange session of month M+1. EXIT: the close of the last exchange session of month M+1 (forced monthly round trip, complete synchronized cohorts, no overlap; it skips the month-boundary overnight gap). Month-end dates come from the full exchange-session calendar cross-checked against SPY's dates, never from a ticker's own next bar. SCORED ACCOUNT (benchmark_plus_overlay): SPY held at all times PLUS 0.5 of equity times (equal-weight cohort return minus the equal-weight return of ALL eligible names over the same entry and exit sessions), costs on both legs, financing of the long leg at the bare 13-week bill rate. The short equal-weight leg is a RESEARCH CONTROL: because both legs hold the same survivors it cancels only the LEVEL of the survivorship and equal-weight baseline of a panel of today's index members. Rank-conditional survivorship (past residual-momentum winners that later failed or were added to the index later) is NOT cancelled, and the permutation placebo, which draws its random cohorts from the same eligible set, shares that limitation and cannot test it, so a pass is inconclusive rather than confirmatory and a failure is the informative outcome. The short leg is not an investable account, and a pass here does not certify an investable long-only strategy. Every constant was fixed ex-ante and none was tuned: the 36-month window, the 11-month formation with a 1-month skip and the score are from the literature; N=50 (about a decile), the 0.5 overlay notional (the Reg-T bound), the placebo seed and draw count and the 0.95 percentile bar are design choices. PRE-REGISTERED PASS RULE: the ledger stage is recorded exactly as the ABI-1 verdict gives it, but a passing stage counts as a pass of this family only when the real rule's overlay Sharpe percentile among the 500 seeded random same-size cohort placebo draws is at least 0.95; otherwise the driver's ledger note leads with CONTROL CONDITION FAILED, the result field pre_registered_pass is false and the result is not promoted. FIRST COHORT: June 2003, the first month with a full 36-month regression window; the eligible set grows over time, so the top 50 is a larger share of it early than late (not a constant decile). Cited evidence is a long-short decile result over 1926-2009 (later work through 2015); the long-only top-50 leg against a cap-weighted benchmark is untested in the sources. The HML proxy (IVE minus IVW) tracks the true factor only loosely, so value exposure is only partly removed. Costs use 2026 quoted spreads for every year (direction unmeasured; plausibly understating early-year costs). The hygiene exclusions (an interior data gap since 2000-05-31, a failed 2026 quote gate) are decided on full-sample or 2026 data and applied to all history: a data-quality rule, not a return-based one, applied equally to both legs. PRE-REGISTRATION HONESTY: no performance of this rule was computed before it was fixed; the only return-based statistics examined on this panel were zero-signal equal-weight controls, which measure the universe, not the signal.

parameters.universe: the project's cached US large-cap panel (current S&P 500 + Nasdaq-100 constituents; today's members, survivorship-biased) minus HUBB and MNST (documented vendor defects) minus the duplicate share classes GOOGL, FOX and NWSA minus any name failing the interior-gap, stale-history, closed-day or quote checks
parameters.factor_proxies: MKT = SPY; SMB-proxy = IWM minus SPY; HML-proxy = IVE minus IVW; monthly total returns from month-end adjusted closes on the exchange session calendar
parameters.regression: OLS with intercept on raw monthly returns (no risk-free subtraction), a full 36 monthly returns required
parameters.score: sum of regression residuals over months M-11..M-1 divided by the sample standard deviation of those same 11 residuals
parameters.decision: close of the last exchange session of month M
parameters.entry: open of the first exchange session of month M+1
parameters.exit: close of the last exchange session of month M+1
parameters.calendar: exchange_calendars XNYS actual sessions, cross-checked against SPY's own dates
parameters.account: benchmark_plus_overlay: SPY held at all times plus overlay_notional_fraction times (equal-weight selected cohort minus equal-weight of all eligible names); the short equal-weight leg is a research control, not an investable account
parameters.financing_rate: ^IRX 13-week bill coupon-equivalent yield of the last close strictly before each session, on the long leg's notional, actual calendar days over 365, no spread; no short rebate or borrow fee
parameters.cost_model: full round trip of the quoted spread on every name of both legs, charged on the exit day

source: Blitz, Huij & Martens (2011), 'Residual momentum', Journal of Empirical Finance 18(3):506-521 (36-month rolling three-factor regression; sum of residuals over months t-12..t-2 scaled by their standard deviation, as restated in Hanauer & Windmuller). Also Blitz, Hanauer & Vidojevic, 'The idiosyncratic momentum anomaly' (SSRN 2947044; International Review of Economics and Finance vol 69, 2020). Scope caveat: the source evidence is a zero-investment top-minus-bottom LONG-SHORT decile result over 1926-2009 (the later paper through 2015 in US data) and the headline advantage over raw momentum comes largely from avoiding the 2009 momentum crash, a short-leg phenomenon; the long-only top-50 leg tested here is not tested in either source. The tradeable factor proxies are imperfect stand-ins for the Ken French monthly factors, the HML proxy most of all.
distinctness_note: CROSS-SECTIONAL ranking of single stocks on FACTOR-ADJUSTED (regression-residual) returns, held as a fixed top-50 cohort and scored as an overlay against the equal-weight of all eligible names on an SPY core, through its own bespoke driver (scripts/run_residual_momentum_overlay_abi1.py; make_signal_fn always raises so the generic dispatch cannot mis-score it). Nearest catalog families: large_cap_single_stock_pooled_tsmom is TIME-SERIES momentum (own sign of trailing 12-month return, long/flat per stock); fifty_two_week_high_momentum ranks on nearness to the 52-week high; overnight_intraday_tilt_pooled_largecap ranks a 21-day overnight-minus-intraday spread. No other catalog family uses a regression residual, an idiosyncratic-return score or any Fama-French-style factor adjustment. New mechanism class: removing time-varying factor exposure from the momentum signal. The scoring account is also new (mining.cohort_overlay: benchmark-plus-overlay with a research-control short leg).
